name: error_machine_limit_reached
description: A create with a NEW name at the account's machine limit answers 403 machine_limit_reached; it keeps its own code (never forbidden) and is not retried.

error.message: You've reached this account's limit of 250 machines. Every machine name you create — including deleted ones — stays yours, so boot one of your existing names instead of creating a new one. How to keep a pool of names and reuse them: https://zipbox.ai/docs/machine-limit. Need more than 250? Email support@tribes.xyz.
